test_title: PYST 50 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate conjunction:

The patient responded well to the treatment, _______ the prognosis remains guarded.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. yet .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The conjunction** "yet"** is used to show contrast between two clauses.
 
• In the given sentence, there is a positive clause ("The patient responded well to the treatment") followed by a contrasting negative clause ("the prognosis remains guarded").
 
• This contrast is best conveyed by using the conjunction **"yet."**

Correct sentence: *The patient responded well to the treatment, **yet** the prognosis remains guarded.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of the other options:**
 
 
• **"Hence":** Indicates cause and effect, which is not suitable for this sentence.
 
• **"Therefore":** Also indicates cause and effect, which doesn’t align with the contrasting ideas in the sentence.
 
• **"Because":** Indicates reason or explanation, which is not appropriate in this context.
